sources.title: Introducing Command A Vision: Multimodal AI built for Business
sources.evidence: July 31, 2025 release: 112B dense full model; separate 111B Command A text tower, SigLIP2-patch16-512 encoder and MLP adapter. Architecture and training discussion concern this exact release. Reopened October 27, 2026: the complete release article still explicitly gives 112B dense full model and a separate 111B Command A text tower. Its staged alignment, SFT and RL description does not supply an active-count convention.

sources.title: Model Card for Cohere Labs Command A Vision
sources.evidence: Public model card identifies the exact release, Cohere/Cohere Labs developers, open weights, nominal 112B, text/image input and text output, CC-BY-NC with acceptable-use terms, and 128K support despite a 32K downloadable default. Reopened October 27: the exact model summary and size field both retain 112B; the architecture explicitly combines Command A with a SigLIP2 encoder and multimodal adapter. No separate active count is given.

sources.title: Announcing Cohere's Command A Vision Model
sources.evidence: Dated July 31, 2025 announcement explicitly names command-a-vision-07-2025, its 128K context, multilingual visual/document tasks and public release.

sources.title: Cohere's Command A Vision Model
sources.evidence: Exact API model ID, 128,000-token context, 8,000-token output limit, visual/document use cases, no image output, and explicit lack of tool use.

sources.title: Command A Vision documentation source
sources.evidence: Exact model's enabled capabilities include safety modes, citations, structured outputs, multilingual and image inputs; reasoning and tool use are excluded. Checked with renderer s6, which explicitly marks excluded capabilities disabled. File last-change commit: 57059a6d637776752183459fd61be90c23251b1b.

sources.title: Cohere ModelShowcase capability renderer
sources.evidence: getCapabilities explicitly computes disabled flags for Reasoning and ToolUse from membership in the exact model's capability list. This resolves flattened page text that otherwise lists disabled badges as plain words. File last-change commit: ed29a0651cbac0ad1b8cf1b8820ffa4c5bc4554d.

sources.title: Official Command A Vision repository metadata
sources.evidence: Repository revision e1016a8105950a626e7dd91b0a3030f7ae522411 exposes a Safetensors aggregate of 111,867,525,360 F16 elements and 50 weight shards. Metadata still declares cc-by-nc-4.0 and a non-commercial license gate. Aggregate metadata is not a tensor-by-tensor learned-parameter audit. Fresh October 27 metadata returns the same revision and 111,867,525,360-element aggregate; this corroborates the nominal 112B total without establishing an active count.

sources.title: CC-BY-NC 4.0 License with Acceptable Use Addendum
sources.evidence: License linked by the exact checkpoint's gate is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 with an acceptable-use addendum.

sources.title: Introducing Command A+: Making sovereign agentic capabilities available to all
sources.evidence: May 20, 2026 comparison table explicitly gives Command A Vision 112B and marks reasoning and tool use unsupported. It gives 218B total/25B active only for A+, not Vision; there is no separate Vision active count. Reopened October 27: the comparison row is labeled Size, not active parameters. Its speed paragraph contrasts A+ with the separate Command A Reasoning model, not Vision, and defines no Vision or language-backbone active-count convention.

sources.title: Explore our models — Command A Vision card
sources.evidence: Current overview's Command A Vision card says Apache 2.0 and links to CohereLabs/command-a-vision-07-2025. Raw HTML confirms the label belongs to this card. This conflicts with the exact checkpoint's CC-BY-NC card and gate.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: Direct config read returned HTTP 401. Raw README and LICENSE attempts also returned 401, but no standalone LICENSE appears in the repository file list. Public rendered card, gate, metadata and linked license terms remained readable. Exact tensor/component validation was not completed.

sources.title: Baseline Hugging Face link access attempt
sources.evidence: Baseline's c4ai-prefixed repository URL returned HTTP 401. The release article instead links to the accessible public card at CohereLabs/command-a-vision-07-2025.

sources.title: Later Command A+ model card
sources.evidence: Reviewed later first-party model card for possible comparison disclosures. Its total/active counts and sparse architecture describe A+, not Command A Vision, and are not transferred to this record. Reopened October 27: its 218B total and 25B active fields remain specific to A+; no Vision active-count comparison is present.

sources.title: Command A language-backbone model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the exact language model linked by the Vision card. It gives 111B nominal parameters and describes its post-training and local/global attention, but publishes no separate active count. The named-base relationship supports the documented language component, not an inferred complete multimodal active count.

sources.title: Command A: An Enterprise-Ready Large Language Model
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete v2 report freshly fetched October 27, including architecture section 2.3, parameter passages and comparison tables. It identifies the 111B Command A language model but does not define an active-parameter convention that can transfer to Vision.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: Independently searched the full later first-party report freshly fetched October 27 for Command A Vision, active/activated parameters and relevant comparison disclosures. No exact Vision active count is present; Tiny Aya embedding/non-embedding totals concern another model and do not establish this field.

name.note: Exact release name and dated API identifier match.

developer.note: Model card credits Cohere and Cohere Labs; Cohere is the catalog developer.

family.note: Release is built upon Command A and appears in the later Command A family comparison.

release_date.note: Dated primary release announcement establishes public availability on July 31, 2025.

open_weights.note: Developer released weights; gated access and license uncertainty do not negate their distribution.

license.note: Exact artifact card and gate declare CC-BY-NC-4.0 plus acceptable-use addendum and link to publicly readable applicable terms. No standalone LICENSE appears in the repository file list; a direct raw LICENSE attempt returned 401. Current overview says Apache 2.0 for the same repository, an unresolved contradiction; this value records the artifact declaration, not a verified relicensing conclusion.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact card, release and later comparison confirm the developer-published nominal 112B complete model. The 111B Command A language tower is a documented component. Current Hub metadata remains 111.867525360B F16 elements; retained as corroboration without replacing published nominal precision or repeating an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/activated and named-base searches, reopened release/card/backbone evidence, and later first-party comparisons found no separate active-count disclosure for Vision or its language component. The A+ table labels Vision 112B as Size; A+ 25B active and Reasoning 111B dense are not Vision specifications. Dense topology and the 111B language total do not establish per-token active parameters, especially across separate image encoding and language decoding.

architecture.note: Developer explicitly describes a dense model: Command A text tower plus SigLIP2 vision encoder and MLP adapter in a LLaVA-style design. Training-time model merging is not inference-time MoE.

context_window.note: Exact API specification is 128,000 tokens. Card supports 128K but says downloadable configuration defaults to 32K; preserve the API limit.

modalities.note: Model card explicitly describes text/image input and text output; API limitations exclude image generation.

reasoning.note: Exact documentation renders native reasoning disabled, and later first-party comparison marks it unsupported. This is a native thinking-mode flag, not a claim of no mathematical or visual reasoning ability.

tool_call.note: Explicit exact-model limitation and later comparison both exclude native tool use.

description.value: Cohere vision model for multilingual document analysis, OCR, and image understanding
description.note: Supported by exact release's documented tasks; no unsupported benchmark or architecture claim in the description.

patch.notes: 112B is Cohere’s nominal complete-model total, including a 111B language tower. Active parameters are not separately disclosed for either scope. API context is 128,000 tokens; downloadable configuration defaults to 32K according to the card. License records the exact checkpoint card/gate declaration and linked public CC-BY-NC-4.0 terms with acceptable-use addendum; Cohere's current overview contradictorily says Apache 2.0 for the same repository. Relicensing was not verified. Native reasoning and tool use are explicitly disabled. The baseline c4ai-prefixed weights URL is not the release's canonical repository.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit confirmed nominal 112B complete model and the documented 111B language component. Fresh exact-model total/active/lineage searches, reopened primary release/card/metadata, the language-backbone card/report, and later Cohere comparisons yielded no separate supported active count. Preserved null active, component data, prior gated-file limitations and all unrelated assessments; no weight shards or repeat census requested.
